def merge_sorted(xs: list[int], ys: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """
    Merge two ascending-sorted lists into one ascending-sorted list.

    pre: all(xs[i] <= xs[i + 1] for i in range(len(xs) - 1))
    pre: all(ys[i] <= ys[i + 1] for i in range(len(ys) - 1))
    pre: not (set(xs) & set(ys))
    post: all(__return__[i] <= __return__[i + 1] for i in range(len(__return__) - 1))
    post: len(__return__) == len(xs) + len(ys)
    post: sorted(__return__) == sorted(xs + ys)
    post: set(__return__) == set(xs) | set(ys)
    """
    result = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(xs) and j < len(ys):
        if xs[i] <= ys[j]:
            result.append(xs[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(ys[j])
            j += 1
    result.extend(xs[i:])
    result.extend(ys[j:])
    return result

def zip_sum(xs: list[int], ys: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Add two lists element by element.

    pre: len(xs) == len(ys)
    pre: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in xs)

    post: len(__return__) == len(xs)
    post: all(__return__[i] == xs[i] + ys[i] for i in range(len(xs)))
    """
    return [x + y for x, y in zip(xs, ys)]
